findings: Production document pagination reconstructs all fixed source units; read capability and stopping behavior are separate.
The B hint did not reliably stop sufficient-summary or local-fact tasks from reading whole documents.
In seven completed A/B pairs, search calls decreased but fetch calls increased and known input tokens did not decrease.
Initial planning sometimes expands scope before the first search result; a search-return hint cannot prevent that earlier decision.
Some agents infer whole-corpus uniqueness from bounded identical search hits or confuse provenance supported with semantic verification.
F24-B-r1 honestly stopped after withdrawal without inventing the unread ending; no compared hint was emitted in that sample.
limitations: Only 22 of 48 planned runs were attempted; repetitions are incomplete. No stable/general causal benefit is established.
Provider interruptions and tool-call schema repairs affect wall time; F19-B-r1 recovered from a member LLM error.
Synthetic repeated text and placeholder IDs triggered integrity investigations; results do not estimate average real-corpus performance.
The hint is emitted only by search results with excerpts; direct document reads and preview-only searches may never receive it.
The source fixture returns one query-independent candidate. Repeated result sets do not by themselves establish semantic query equivalence.
Source coverage remains unknown; reading all ingested units does not prove original PDF extraction completeness.
Four artifact-bound model reviews remain needs_review: two diagnostic fail, two unassessed due unsupported extra claims. No human PASS was assigned.

scoring_correction.reason: The approved corpus cases allow direct delivery; the inherited web teamwork gate wrongly required a sub-agent.

next_repair_direction: Keep original user-required answer fields and reading scope in the coordinator task contract; do not add uniqueness, full reading or metadata checks without a necessary gap.
Reuse already delivered evidence across research and verification; track remaining necessary gaps instead of assigning an independent full reread by default.
Represent permanent source withdrawal as a non-retryable acquisition outcome and test stop behavior separately from missing-content recovery.
Use realistic content-derived IDs and varied long-form synthetic prose in a separately reviewed follow-up set; do not overwrite this frozen dataset or its failures.
